issue.title: capture-parse never reports multi_note_marker refusals that bob capture makes
issue.description:
`bob capture-parse` (the editor resolver Bob Mac Capture reads) never reports the
`multi_note_marker` refusal that `bob capture` makes for a note-less `@route+id`
item with first-level bullets plus an item-wide `s:<N>`, `$<N>`, or `%c`. The
editor shows a clean draft (`needs: []`, `diagnostics: []`), and the error only
appears when the dry-run preview or the commit runs. That breaks the "one
resolver serves the menu, capture-parse, the dry-run preview, and the commit"
claim in decisions:capture-bullets-mirror-the-task-block.

Execution refuses in `resolve_sub_bullet_kind` (src/native/capture_language/item.rs)
and `plan_multi_note_sub_bullet_item` (src/native/capture/plan.rs). On master,
`grep multi_note src/native/capture_language/editor_*.rs` finds no hits, so the
editor never emits this code.

Found while planning `%c` support for note-less `@route+id` (clipboard notes
under an existing task). That plan changes the related `type_marker_needs_task`
editor predicate, but this gap is a separate fix.

task_type_fields.impact: Bob Mac Capture's editor shows no error for an invalid multi-note draft; Bryan sees the refusal only in the preview or after pressing Capture.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/capture_language/editor_parse.rs (missing multi_note_marker diagnostic; execution side in capture_language/item.rs resolve_sub_bullet_kind)
task_type_fields.repro:
```bash
bob capture-parse -f json $'@cash+goog-exit s:2\n- a'   # needs: [], diagnostics: []
bob capture --dry-run -f json $'@cash+goog-exit s:2\n- a'
# {"code":"multi_note_marker","error":"... `s:2` decorates a single note: ..."}
bob capture-parse -f json $'@cash+goog-exit %c\n- a'    # needs: [], diagnostics: []
bob capture --dry-run --no-clip -f json $'@cash+goog-exit %c\n- a'
# {"code":"multi_note_marker","error":"... `%c` decorates a single note: ..."}
```
Run against any vault with a `cash.md` task `^goog-exit`. Reproduced on athena
with the installed bob, and confirmed in master source (no editor emitter).

issue.creation_reason: Found while planning %c support for note-less @route+id: the editor resolver shows a clean draft for multi-note items that the commit refuses, so the error appears only at preview time.
